question_en:
I am checking a type of English information material for each vaccine shown in the chart: materials issued by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) for vaccine recipients or their guardians to read, explaining the benefits and risks of the vaccine. First, determine the official name of these materials. Then, check each item one by one from top to bottom in the vaccine column on the left side of the chart. When the same vaccine family occupies multiple consecutive rows, count it as only one item. For the influenza item, verify against the inactivated influenza material; for the "Tdap or Td" item, verify uniformly against the Tdap material. Stop when the year of the current English version of a material is first earlier than 2025. This question concerns only document versions, not personal vaccination recommendations. Please answer the following questions:
1. What is the official English name of these materials? Which vaccine families were verified in order? List the current English version date for each corresponding material and the judgment of "Continue" or "Stop." Which vaccine first met the stopping condition of having a version year earlier than 2025?

Answer format: First, state the official English name of the materials in text. Then, use a table to list the vaccine families, their current English version dates, and the "Continue/Stop" judgment in order. Vaccines that trigger the stop condition should be directly reflected in the table; there is no need to repeat the answer.
answer:
(1) Official English name: Vaccine Information Statement (VIS).

| Verification Order | Vaccine Family | Current English Version Date | Judgment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COVID-19 | 2025-01-31 | Continue |
| 2 | Influenza (inactivated) | 2025-01-31 | Continue |
| 3 | RSV | 2025-01-31 | Continue |
| 4 | Tdap | 2025-01-31 | Continue |
| 5 | MMR | 2025-01-31 | Continue |
| 6 | Varicella | 2025-01-31 | Continue |
| 7 | Zoster / Shingles (recombinant) | 2022-02-04 | Stop |
